notes.title: Kindred [Subject 6244] Patch 1.1.0 Notes
notes.content:
[i]Scroll down for Russian Translation[/i]
[i]Прокрутите вниз для русского перевода![/i]

[b]Dear Players![/b]

Thank you so much for all of your support and love.
I can't thank you all enough!

This is a two month patch that includes a ton of changes to the Russian translation, as well as some changes to the English translation that notably identify the organization's name as "The Komitet."

There are a few other changes to some text that wasn't readable due to font changes. 
I hope you're all enjoying the winter sale, and wish you all happy holidays!

Thanks for being awesome.
A reminder that you're more than welcome to join the Kindred server! 
https://discord.gg/hJNk4QBsjY

Any and all fanart I've seen is so gorgeous. 
See you soon y'all!

[b]A Quick Reminder:[/b]
Kindred [SnowBound] is now available for wishlist, alongside a quick Demo!
If you're interested in more from the Kindred universe, check it out!

[b]Дорогие игроки![/b]

Огромное спасибо за вашу поддержку и любовь.
Я не могу выразить вам всю свою благодарность!

Это двухмесячный патч включает в себя тонну изменений в русском переводе, а также некоторые изменения в английском переводе. Эти изменения, в частности, определяют название организации как «Комитет».

Есть еще несколько изменений в тексте, который был нечитабельным из-за изменения шрифта. 
Надеюсь, вы все наслаждаетесь зимней распродажей и желаю всем счастливых праздников!

Спасибо всем за внимание!
Напоминаю, что вы можете присоединиться к серверу Kindred! 
https://discord.gg/hJNk4QBsjY

Все фанарты, которые я видела, просто великолепны. 
До скорой встречи!

[b]Небольшое напоминание:[/b]
Kindred [SnowBound] теперь доступен для желающих, наряду с быстрым демо!
Если вам интересно узнать больше о Kindred, загляните сюда!

Переведено с помощью DeepL.com (бесплатная версия)

notes.title: Kindred [Subject 6244] One Month News Update
notes.content:
[b][h2]Published OST[/h2][/b]
The official soundtrack for Kindred [Subject 6244] is now available on YouTube. 

I plan to publish the OST as Steam DLC as well for those that are willing to donate at most a dollar to the project to download the official files. If you simply want to listen for free, then the official soundtrack is currently available on YouTube. 

[previewyoutube=N_Y601Q4fTo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[b][h2]Fan Art Showcase[/h2][/b]
Special Thanks to the lovely artists featured below for some splendid fanart!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180807/8d4b85d75d0049b95fd7612e82df431cdb4a393c.jpg[/img]

Thank you so much to Simp and Sleepy for the wonderful art :)



[b][h2]Russian Dub Fix[/h2][/b]
I have been getting some help with a fix for the Russian Dub, as it isn't perfect at the moment. We are about half-way done translating, and the updated version should be released in the next few weeks. 
I'm super thankful for all of the Russian players that have played through the game, especially Cthulha Game who was kind enough to share their gameplay on YouTube. 



[b][h2]Something New[/h2][/b]
Kindred's story has only just begun.
This is the first entry in a longer series all taking place in the same universe, and I am currently in the midst of getting feedback for the newest prototype of another game in the series. 
I appreciate all of your support so much. If you have a chance, please leave a steam review if you haven't! :)
